title: ‘It was either sleeping at Price Center or … the bushes’: Students suffer as UCSD faces a historic heat wave - The UCSD Guardian

“You can pay for a big a– mansion, but you can’t pay for an AC unit in our dorms,” third-year student Rigoberto Sanchez Mejia said in an interview with The UCSD Guardian, criticizing Chancellor Pradeep Khosla over university spending priorities during a record-breaking heat wave.
Students were left to suffer in their dorms after a historic heat wave hit San Diego last week from Oct. 2 to Oct. 8. According to UC San Diego’s Housing Dining Hospitality, all campus dorms and housing units do not have air conditioning due to La Jolla’s mild weather and the university’s proximity to ocean breezes. Yet as climate change continues to accelerate, temperate coastal climates are no longer enough to protect uncooled dorms from rising temperatures.
Temperatures at peak moments exceeded mid-90 degrees, leaving students to search for creative measures to fight the heat. This most recent heat wave in October followed a broader pattern San Diego County has witnessed over the past few months. In early September, a heat advisory was sent to all of San Diego County’s climate zones, including the coasts, inland valleys, deserts and mountains. Escondido reached a record-breaking high temperature of 112 degrees, while in El Cajon temperatures climbed to an extreme temperature of 108 degrees.
The World Health Organization cites that extreme heat exacerbates chronic illnesses such as asthma, diabetes and cardiovascular disease. During heat wave conditions, the human body’s ability to regulate internal temperatures is strained, spiking the risk of heat exhaustion and heatstroke. In 2023, heatstroke represented 33.6% of hospitalizations from heat-related illnesses in San Diego County.
Fourth-year student Arushi Mathur shared that the recent spike in temperatures has become an issue.
“I live in [the] Pepper Canyon West apartments where the sun passes through the windows,” Mathur said in an interview with The UCSD Guardian. “If I turned the fan on, hot air would circulate.” Mathur noted how most campus dorms, including the newly renovated buildings, are not equipped with air conditioning units.
When sharing how the heat has affected her physical health, Mathur recalled sleeping with “wet, cold towels” throughout her bed to cool off.
“One of my friends was feeling very unwell,” Mathur said. “He told me he slept in Price Center.”
That friend was Mejia, who had to resort to sleeping outside of his dorm due to the excessive heat.
“It was either sleeping at Price Center or sleeping in the bushes,” Mejia said in an interview with The Guardian. “That is a crazy thing to say, but it’s just crazy in the sense that you had to get to that point to even consider it.”
Mejia then recalled packing his essentials, including a blanket and a phone charger, when planning his overnight stay at Price Center. He mentioned that he chose not to bring a pillow to avoid raising campus security’s suspicion about sleeping in a forbidden place.
“At least I wasn’t getting heat stroke,” Mejia said.
Other students observed a larger issue, viewing the heat wave’s toll on campus daily life as a reflection of broader systemic unpreparedness. First-year student Diego Sandoval noted the university’s inattention and inadequate institutional responses to mitigating heat caused by the climate crisis.
“The U.S. is not prepared for a changing climate,” Sandoval said in an interview with The Guardian “I don’t want to single UCSD out, but it’s the lack of capacity of states and other funding entities to provide funds for the climate transition.”
An email sent on Oct. 2 by Naraj Dangoria, vice chancellor for Operations Management and Capital Programs, and Alysson Satterlund, vice chancellor for Student Affairs and Campus Life, provided a list of air-conditioned spaces in Geisel Library, RIMAC and Price Center during limited hours.
“What do you mean these air-conditioned spaces are ‘scheduled’ in a campus where thousands of students are enrolled?” Mathur said.
For students like Sandoval, temporary measures like scheduled cooling centers miss the fundamental point.
“It should be an expectation, not a premium, to have a livable campus,” he said.

Isniin, October 19, 2026 (HOL) – Garsooraha Soomaaliyeed Cumar Cabdulkaadir Cartan ayaa loo magacaabay inuu dhex-dhexaadiyo kulanka xulalka Morocco iyo Niger, kaas oo qeyb ka ah isreebreebka Koobka Qaramada Afrika ee AFCON 2027.
Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Afrika (CAF) ayaa magacaabay garsoorayaasha maamuli doona labada kulan ee isku xiga ee Morocco iyo Niger, kuwaas oo lagu ciyaari doono gudaha Morocco.
Cumar Cartan ayaa loo xilsaaray kulanka koowaad oo labada xul ay ku ciyaari doonaan garoonka Mohammed V Sports Complex ee magaalada Casablanca, 13-ka November.
Garsooraha Soomaaliyeed waxaa caawin doona Hamza Haji Abdi iyo Ali Mahamud Mahad, kuwaas oo loo magacaabay garsoorayaal kaaliye ah.
Kulanka labaad ee labada xul ayaa la qorsheeyay inuu ka dhaco garoonka Prince Moulay Abdellah ee magaalada Rabat, 17-ka November, waxaana dhex-dhexaadin doona garsoore u dhashay Itoobiya, Tewodros Mitiku, oo ay wehelin doonaan laba garsoore oo kale oo Itoobiyaan ah.
Labada kulan ayaa qeyb ka ah wareegyada saddexaad iyo afraad ee isreebreebka AFCON 2027. Kulanka Casablanca ayaa bilaaban doona 8:00 fiidnimo, waqtiga maxalliga ah, iyadoo kulanka labaadna la qorsheeyay inuu isla waqtigaas bilowdo.
Xulka Morocco ayaa hoggaaminaya Group A, kaddib markii uu guulo ka gaaray Gabon iyo Lesotho bishii September. Laba guulood oo uu ka helo Niger ayaa sii xoojin kara hoggaankiisa iyo rajadiisa u soo bixitaanka tartanka.
Magacaabista Cumar Cartan ayaa fursad kale u ah garsooraha Soomaaliyeed inuu ka dhex muuqdo tartamada heerka qaaradeed, isaga oo loo igmaday maamulidda kulan muhiim u ah isreebreebka koobka ugu weyn ee xulalka qaranka Afrika.

full_text:
The cities of Cusco and Urubamba, located in the Sacred Valley of the Incas, have seen temperatures exceed 28°C and 30°C this month—surpassing figures recorded during the same period in previous years—according to the National Service of Meteorology and Hydrology (Senamhi).
Senamhi specialist Elizabeth Díaz Carhuaricra confirmed that the Cusco region is experiencing exceptionally high temperatures.
“We are seeing anomalies of 3 to 4 degrees above the typical temperatures we are accustomed to. These values ??are being exceeded across virtually the entire Cusco department,” said Díaz.
“While we have seen such temperatures before, those were isolated, atypical occurrences, not the sustained, consecutive events we are experiencing during this time of year,” she added.
Díaz Carhuaricra explained that Cusco has experienced very clear, cloudless days with no rainfall.
“There is very little moisture moving into the area, the heat feels intense, and ultraviolet radiation is extremely strong,” she noted.
She indicated that these high temperatures—accompanied by a lack of rainfall—could persist until early next autumn, as part of the disruptive effects caused by the El Niño phenomenon.
Meanwhile, she noted that this intense heat was briefly tempered last weekend when the city and parts of the region experienced short-lived rainfall, which even helped to mitigate some forest fires.
According to the specialist, the region has entered its twelfth cold spell (*friaje*), which is helping to reduce the impact of the heat by bringing a degree of moisture and cloud cover to the highland areas of the region. It was also noted that there was cloud cover in the jungle region (Paucartambo, Quispicanchi), which reduces the perceived heat.
“Furthermore, liquid and solid precipitation is expected in the higher-altitude areas,” she emphasized.
“Following this, we will experience warmer days, as the El Niño phenomenon leads to a reduction in rainfall in the city of Cusco. Compared to other years under normal conditions, we will see more days with less cloud cover. In previous years, there were more cloudy days during these months,” she concluded.

ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్లో వర్షాలు కురిసే అవకాశం ఉందని రాష్ట్ర విపత్తుల నిర్వహణ సంస్థ (APSDMA) వెల్లడించింది. మంగళవారం (అక్టోబర్ 20) రాష్ట్రంలోని పలు జిల్లాల్లో పిడుగులతో కూడిన వర్షాలు పడే అవకాశం ఉందని తెలిపింది. కొన్ని ప్రాంతాల్లో తేలికపాటి నుంచి మోస్తరు వర్షాలు కురిసే అవకాశం ఉన్నందున ప్రజలు అప్రమత్తంగా ఉండాలని సూచించింది. ఏపీఎస్డీఎంఏ వెల్లడించిన వివరాల ప్రకారం.. అల్లూరి సీతారామరాజు, పశ్చిమగోదావరి, ఏలూరు, కృష్ణా, గుంటూరు, బాపట్ల, నెల్లూరు జిల్లాల్లో అక్కడక్కడ పిడుగులతో కూడిన తేలికపాటి నుంచి మోస్తరు వర్షాలు కురిసే అవకాశం ఉంది. ఇక మిగతా జిల్లాల్లోనూ అక్కడక్కడ తేలికపాటి నుంచి మోస్తరు వర్షాలు పడే సూచనలు ఉన్నట్లు సంస్థ తెలిపింది.
పిడుగుల పట్ల జాగ్రత్త!
వర్షాలు కురిసే సమయంలో పిడుగులు పడే ప్రమాదం ఉన్నందున ప్రజలు జాగ్రత్తలు తీసుకోవాలి. ఉరుములు, మెరుపులు ప్రారంభమైనప్పుడు బహిరంగ ప్రదేశాల్లో ఉండకూడదు. చెట్ల కింద ఆశ్రయం పొందడం, విద్యుత్ స్తంభాలు, తీగల సమీపంలో నిలబడటం వంటివి చేయకూడదు. ముఖ్యంగా రైతులు వ్యవసాయ పనులు చేసే సమయంలో వాతావరణ పరిస్థితులను గమనిస్తూ అప్రమత్తంగా ఉండాలి. అధికారిక వాతావరణ హెచ్చరికలను ఎప్పటికప్పుడు పరిశీలించాలని సూచిస్తున్నారు.
మొత్తంగా.. మంగళవారం ఏపీలోని పలు జిల్లాల్లో వర్షాలు కురిసే అవకాశం ఉండటంతో ప్రజలు, రైతులు అప్రమత్తంగా ఉండాలి. మీ ప్రాంతంలో వర్షం కురిసే సూచనలు ఉన్నాయో లేదో స్థానిక వాతావరణ సమాచారాన్ని గమనించండి.
